comment: ARC 030 / Stage 2 A3. Tracked, justified exceptions for check_untracked_attribution's foreign-commit arm — a NON-LIVE local branch, with commits this arc's HEAD does not contain, touching a path canonical HEAD already tracks. Matched on the exact branch name; an untracked branch not listed here is always FAIL_NEEDS_OPERATOR, never silently skipped. See check_untracked_attribution.py's module docstring and downloads/arc_030_stage2_a_isolation.md for how the first two were found (a real, unplanned discovery while proving the arm works against the live canonical repo, not a hypothetical). ARC 031 / 0.5 — EMPTY, and empty by DISCHARGE rather than by suppression. The architect ruled the two archival branches (docs/arc002-results, docs/arc005-writeback) deleted: both were superseded RESULTS/SESSION snapshots with no unique content, each exactly one commit ahead of main, and both were verified byte-identical to their origin/ counterparts BEFORE the local refs were removed — so nothing outward-facing was touched and nothing is unrecoverable (git branch <name> origin/<name> restores either). The arm enumerates refs/heads only, so with the local refs gone it finds zero foreign commits and the gate discharges GUARDED -> PASS. That discharge was MEASURED after the deletion, not asserted before it. An empty list is the healthy state this file documents; the next entry must again name one branch and justify it.
